outlook.statement: Cautiously optimistic for FY27; priorities include accelerating Kohli integration to realize synergies across flexible packaging value chain, optimizing product mix toward higher-margin value-added offerings, continuing R&D investment for technology leadership, and strengthening export pipeline as global markets normalize

The Company continues to focus on operational efficiency, cost optimisation, timely execution of orders and strengthening its market presence, thereby reinforcing its long-term growth prospects and commitment to creating sustainable value for its stakeholders.
REBPL remains committed to strengthening its market position through prudent financial management, customer-centric execution and continuous improvement in its operational processes.

The global plastics market is projected to grow from USD 560.38 billion in 2026 to USD 832.62 billion by 2034, exhibiting a CAGR of 5.1%. The Asia-Pacific region remains dominant, accounting for approximately 53% of the global plastics market in 2025. The global plastic processing machinery market is projected to grow from USD 24.63 billion in 2026 to USD 38.07 billion by 2034 at a CAGR of 5.6%. The global plastic extrusion machinery market is anticipated to be valued at USD 16.23 billion in 2026, with projected growth to USD 27.68 billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 6.9%. India's plastics industry is projected to grow from US$ 26.61 billion in 2025 to US$ 44.59 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of approximately 10.9%. India's plastics processing market is forecast to reach USD 63.69 billion by 2031, expanding at a CAGR of 6.24%. The plastic processing machinery segment in India is estimated at USD 33.93 billion in 2025 and projected to reach USD 42.27 billion by 2030, reflecting a CAGR of 4.49%.

Management remains cautiously optimistic for FY27. While near-term headwinds such as raw material price volatility, logistics costs, and geopolitical uncertainties may persist, demand visibility remains strong across key markets. The Company is focusing on enhancing profitability through cost optimization, improved procurement efficiency, product mix rationalization, and greater emphasis on value-added, higher-margin offerings. Aligning strategies with growing demand from flexible packaging, infrastructure, agriculture, electronics, healthcare and renewable energy sectors. Strong emphasis on sustainability aligned with K-2025 theme 'The Power of Plastics: Green - Smart - Responsible'. Well-positioned to deliver sustainable growth over the medium term.

The Company is committed to integrating environmental, social and governance (ESG) considerations into its business operations. Its key focus areas include improving energy and resource efficiency, increasing the use of renewable energy, maintaining high standards of occupational health and safety, ensuring regulatory compliance, enhancing employee development and strengthening corporate governance practices.
